children: Darden Restaurants reported fiscal 2027 first-quarter sales of $3.20 billion and diluted net earnings per share from continuing operations of $2.05 for the quarter ended August 30, 2026. Blended same-restaurant sales rose 3.1% on a fiscal calendar basis (3.2% on a comparable calendar basis), and the company repurchased $222.3 million of common stock during the quarter. The board declared a quarterly cash dividend of $1.62 per share and reaffirmed full-year fiscal 2027 diluted EPS guidance of $11.10 to $11.35.
Revenue: Total sales of $3,200.3 million for the quarter ended 8/30/2026 (prior year $3,044.7 million).
Operating income: $319.3 million for the quarter (8/30/2026).
Net earnings from continuing operations: $234.3 million for the quarter; diluted net earnings per share from continuing operations $2.05.
Adjusted diluted net earnings per share from continuing operations: $2.05 (adjusted reconciliation shown in release).
Share repurchases and capital return: Repurchased approximately $222.3 million of common stock during the quarter; quarterly cash dividend declared of $1.62 per share payable November 2, 2026.
Same-restaurant sales momentum: Blended same-restaurant sales increased 3.1% on a fiscal calendar basis and 3.2% on a comparable calendar basis, with brand-level strength led by LongHorn Steakhouse.

Brand performance: LongHorn Steakhouse posted the strongest same-restaurant sales growth at 6.2% (6.8% on comparable calendar); Olive Garden and Fine Dining brands also delivered positive same-restaurant sales.
Restaurant footprint changes: Company-owned restaurants totaled 2,218 at 8/30/2026, up from 2,165 at 8/24/2025, with increases across several brands including Olive Garden and LongHorn.
Portfolio actions: Bahama Breeze locations continuing transition—locations expected to be closed or converted by Q4 fiscal 2027; closures of underperforming restaurants noted in prior periods.

Operational focus and outlook: Management emphasized priorities to operate restaurants at a high level, strengthen guest loyalty, invest in people and brands, and deploy capital to support long-term shareholder value, while reaffirming fiscal 2027 outlook.
